cs.t: Loop earbuds for $30. I keep them on my keys and I have great hearing protection available, and unlike traditional earplugs they filter rather than block noise so I can still hear conversations normally.
cs.th: Ask HN: What are your best purchases under $100?

cs.t: Little overpriced but I've found Loop Earplugs to help working in coffee shops, etc. Muffles out most of the sound but not everything, enough to focus but not fly off your seat if someone taps your shoulder.
